|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Attack Pattern Delta (V) (Virtual Set 4)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “During a battle at a site, if you are about to draw a card for battle destiny, you may instead use the maneuver number of your combat vehicle in that battle.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “During a battle at a site, if you are about to draw a card for battle destiny, you may instead use the maneuver number of your participating combat vehicle.” '''What changed:''' added “participating”; “vehicle in that battle.” → “vehicle.”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153629/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards4.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 2, slip 02. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Attack Pattern Delta]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth#Cards|Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
